_doc: The 8 shapes (docs/03 §5.1, canon v2). mult x flame power = hit damage; oil per cast (per second for beam; tether adds upkeep oil/s while it lives); times in seconds; speed cells/s; size = radius cells; tickRate per second (tether: at most one tick per enemy per hitGap s).

list.name: Arc
list.desc: A close sweep in front of you that also knocks back small projectiles.

list.name: Lob
list.desc: An arcing throw that bursts where it lands.

list.name: Beam
list.desc: A held line of flame. Costs oil every second.

list.name: Ring
list.desc: An expanding nova around you. Pushes enemies away.

list.name: Rune
list.desc: A trap glyph on a surface that bursts when something steps on it.

list.name: Wave
list.desc: Runs along the ground, climbing steps.

list.name: Tether
list.desc: A line between two points: a rope you can climb, and a hazard for anything crossing it.
